descriptionByLocale.it:

Come studente di lavoro:in, tirocinante:in o tirocinante sei una parte importante dei nostri #TeamSiemens. Vuoi anche partecipare attivamente al polso del tempo e rendere migliore la vita di milioni di persone in Svizzera? Allora hai proprio ragione con noi! Applicare oggi come stagista: nella gestione multimediale e degli eventi – il vostro team vi aspetta! Le nuove attività
• Supporto amministrativo e organizzativo del team ICC (Inspiration & Convention Center)
• Prenotazione di locali, assistenza nell'organizzazione di eventi, supporto e consulenza di clienti interni ed esterni
• Una stretta collaborazione con gli organismi interni e con i partner esterni: all'interno come i catering: all'interno, i tecnici: all'interno e i fornitori di servizi: all'interno
• Supporto dell'equipaggio di trasmissione in produzioni video
• Supporto per il supporto tecnico degli eventi tramite il semplice software di streaming
• Organizzare, pianificare e effettuare varie visite guidate attraverso la CPI (ad esempio sala esperienza, visite di fabbrica, ecc.)
• Sviluppo indipendente di vari mezzi di comunicazione (ad esempio nel settore dei social media, ecc.), statistiche e feedback
• Supporto per eventi
• Collaborazione su vari progetti e realizzazione dei vostri progetti I tuoi talenti ed esperienze
• Istruzione: laurea completata e intenzione di completare un master nel prossimo futuro o iscriversi a un FH svizzero o università
• Metodo di lavoro: azione attiva e alta iniziativa, ben organizzato con un metodo di lavoro strutturato, comportamento calmo anche in situazioni frenetiche
• Competenze linguistiche: Molto buone competenze in tedesco e inglese nella parola e nella scrittura
• Lavoro mobile in Svizzera
• Costruire una rete di carriera internazionale
• Ottieni esperienza in uno dei maggiori datori di lavoro tecnologici della Svizzera

Intern: in Multimedia & Event Management 80-100% Together with our customers, we connect the real and the digital world. As one of the leading technology companies, Siemens employs around 6,000 people in Switzerland. With our groundbreaking solutions in the areas of building technology, energy, mobility, health and industry, we are shaping the future. As a working student:in, intern:in or trainee you are an important part of our #TeamSiemens. Do you also want to actively participate in the pulse of time and make the lives of millions of people in Switzerland better? Then you are exactly right with us! Apply today as an intern: in multimedia and event management – your team is looking forward to you! Your new tasks
• Administrative and organizational support of the ICC team (Inspiration & Convention Center)
• Reservation of premises, assistance in the organization of events, support and advice of internal and external customers
• Close cooperation with internal bodies and external partners: inside such as caterers: inside, technicians: inside and service providers: inside
• Support of the broadcast crew in video productions
• Support for technical support of events by operating simple streaming software
• Organize, plan and carry out various guided tours through the ICC (e.g. Experience room, factory tours, etc.)
• Independent development of various means of communication (e.g. in the area of social media, etc.), statistics and feedbacks
• Support for events
• Collaboration on various projects and taking over your own projects Your talents and experiences
• Education: Completed bachelor's degree and intention to complete a master's degree in the near future or enrolled at a Swiss FH or university
• Working method : Proactive action and high initiative, well organized with a structured working method, calm behavior even in hectic situations
• Language skills : Very good German and English skills in word and writing Your advantages
• Mobile work throughout Switzerland
• Building an international career network
• Gain experience at one of Switzerland’s largest tech employers
• Membership in the 200-member Siemens Student Association Our corporate culture - your new working environment The culture at Siemens Switzerland is more than just a working environment – it is at the heart of our daily cooperation and the key to our success. Siemens Switzerland offers a future-oriented working environment characterized by innovation, sustainability and personal development. We are characterized by personal responsibility, equal opportunities and diversity, in which every employee can contribute authentically. Flexible working models and mobile working are a reality for us and enable our employees to achieve a balanced work-life balance. Learn more and discover with our cultural quiz whether you are a fit for Siemens! « Whether in office life or at networking events, at Siemens I always feel welcome and have the opportunity to contribute and learn. » (Working student Computer Science) Get to know us personally! We are currently on tour with the Siemens Boost Bus and offer exciting workshops in the Study Hub. All dates and registration options can be found here
• Meet us at the Siemens Boost Bus at your university [Link]
• Connect with other students in the Siemens Study Hub
• [Place for other current campaigns/events]
• Measuring? Frequently Asked Questions and your contact person Here you will find a collection of frequently asked questions as well as the opportunity to contact us directly. I look forward to your application. Thank you for your understanding.
